meta_title: Image Saturation Tool | Enhance & Saturate Photos Free
meta_description: Boost image saturation online instantly. Make colors pop and enhance dull photos securely in your browser with our free saturation tool.
subtitle: Bring your photos to life by boosting their colors. Adjust the image saturation intensity to make colors pop instantly.

tool_workspace.description: Upload your images and slide the saturation bar to enhance colors.

requirements.intro: Saturation is how intense the colours are. The slider uses the same formula as the CSS saturate() filter, so 100% leaves colours unchanged.

rows.value: Black and white: all colour is removed while brightness is kept.
Muted, faded colours, often used for a vintage or calm look.
Richer, more vivid colours. 200% is the starting value.

rows.label: Above 200%
rows.value: Very strong colours. Skin tones can turn orange and bright colours can lose detail.

notes: For portraits, stay around 110–130% so skin looks natural.
Landscapes, food and product photos usually handle stronger settings well.
To make a photo black and white, set the slider to 0%.
Your file keeps its format: a JPG stays a JPG (saved at 92% quality), a PNG or WebP keeps its transparency.

how_to.title: How to change the saturation of an image
how_to.step1_text: Select or drag in one or more JPG, PNG or WebP files. They stay on your device.
how_to.step2_text: Move the slider: 0% for black and white, above 100% for more vivid colours.
how_to.step3_text: Click the apply button. One image downloads directly; several download as a ZIP.

items.q: How do I make a photo black and white?
items.a: Set the saturation slider to 0%. Colour is removed and the light and dark areas stay the same.
Skin tones are already warm, so high saturation exaggerates them. Use a lower setting such as 110–130% for portraits.

items.q: Can I edit several photos at once?
items.a: Yes. All selected images get the same setting and download together as a ZIP.
No. Processing happens in your browser.
